p.0: A decade of precision engineering, technological innovation, and unwavering commitment to industrial performance - discover the Gausin story.
p.1: Gausin International Engineers Pvt. Ltd. was founded with a singular vision: to bring world-class, technologically advanced, environmentally friendly, and energy-efficient industrial process engineering solutions to Indian and global industries at competitive costs, without compromising on quality or performance.
p.2: Headquartered in Meerut, Uttar Pradesh, we have grown from a specialized evaporator manufacturer to a full-spectrum industrial engineering company. Our expertise spans the complete lifecycle of process plants - from initial feasibility and process design to detailed engineering, fabrication, supply, installation, commissioning, and after-sales support.
p.3: With a team of dedicated process engineers, fabricators, and project managers, we have successfully delivered 100+ projects across eight diverse industrial sectors - dairy, pharmaceutical, food processing, chemical, distillery, paper, textile, and energy.
p.4: To deliver technologically advanced, energy-efficient, and reliable industrial process equipment and engineering solutions that optimize our clients' production performance, reduce operating costs, and exceed international quality standards.
p.5: To be recognized as India's most trusted and globally competitive industrial process engineering company, setting benchmarks in evaporation, drying, and plant engineering technology while contributing to sustainable industrial growth.
p.11: Let our experienced engineering team analyze your requirements and propose the most efficient solution for your industrial process needs.
team.bio.0: Mr. Gaurav Singhal is a Chemical Engineer and an accomplished business leader with over 25 years of dynamic experience in industrial operations, plant design and engineering, project management, business development, and organizational leadership. As the Founder & Chief Executive Officer, he provides strategic direction to the company, driving innovation, operational excellence, and sustainable growth. His extensive industry knowledge, combined with a strong focus on customer satisfaction and quality delivery, has been instrumental in successfully executing complex engineering projects. Under his leadership, the company continues to strengthen its market presence, build lasting client relationships, and deliver value-driven solutions across diverse sectors. Mr. Singhal is committed to fostering a culture of professionalism, integrity, and continuous improvement, ensuring that the organization remains at the forefront of excellence and customer trust.
team.bio.1: Mr. Vijay Kumar Dubey is a dynamic leader with extensive expertise in organizational management, business operations, and customer relationship development. As a Director, he has been instrumental in driving the company's growth through his strategic vision, commitment to customer satisfaction, and focus on quality service delivery. He has played a key role in the successful establishment and execution of infrastructure projects by fostering strong stakeholder relationships, ensuring operational excellence, and promoting a culture of integrity and professionalism. His leadership continues to guide the organization toward sustainable growth and long-term value creation for clients and partners.

timeline.desc.0: Gausin International Engineers was established in Meerut with a focus on evaporator design and supply for the pharmaceutical industry.
timeline.desc.1: Successfully expanded product portfolio to include spray dryers, serving the food and pharmaceutical sectors.
timeline.desc.2: Delivered first major pharmaceutical evaporation system to Nectar Lifesciences - marking entry into the pharma sector.
timeline.desc.3: Established full turnkey project execution capability - design, fabrication, installation, and commissioning under one roof.
timeline.desc.4: Strengthened our presence in the dairy sector by providing modern milk chilling centers designed for efficient milk collection, rapid cooling, and quality assurance.
timeline.desc.5: Launched next-generation IoT-enabled process plant solutions with real-time remote monitoring, predictive maintenance, and data analytics.
timeline.desc.6: Expanded our operations into Canada and the United States of America, strengthening our international footprint and market reach.
